transcript.text:
Welcome, everyone. I'm Mara, and I'm glad you're all here. Let me walk through how this will work.

We have one counter space available for a Saturday food pop-up from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The cafe can provide one six-foot counter, access to a hand-washing sink, and ordinary electrical outlets.

Each of you — Luis, Hana, Dev, and Keira — will get one named turn to submit a complete formal proposal. Your proposal should cover payment, sales share, menu, quantity, and setup access time. Please use the formal reveal action when you submit so I can properly record it under your name.

Once all four formal submissions are in, I'll compare them. The posted rule is simple: the proposal with the greatest upfront payment wins. If there's a tie on upfront payment, the proposal with the greatest quantity wins.

After I've made my decision, I'll record everything in my closing ledger — each vendor's stated figures, the chosen vendor, and the agreed terms.

Let's get started. Luis, would you like to go first?
